The initial white blood cell count is printed as 17.60 in Table 1 and as 16.60 in the text. Both versions are kept review-only.
Alpha-fetoprotein is printed as 2.2 ng/mL in Table 1 and as 1.6 ng/mL in the text. Both versions are kept review-only.

Table 1 lists Calcium 15.2 mg/dL (not stated as corrected) while the text gives a corrected calcium of 15.5 mg/dL. They are recorded as separate observations because the source does not identify them as the same measurement.
The carcinoembryonic antigen value 1.5 ng/mL is printed with reference range 0.0 - 2.4 ng/mL in Table 1 and <5.0 ng/mL in the text. The reference range is left unset on the observation.
The abstract describes a 15 cm liver mass while the case text and Figure 1 caption give the largest CT component as 19.1 x 14.7 cm. The source does not say they are the same measurement.
The abstract says the patient died after three months of his diagnosis while the case text says within three months of his diagnosis. The case text wording is used.

PET-CT findings were described as suspicious for metastatic disease, while the conclusion calls the case metastatic adenosquamous cholangiocarcinoma without bony metastasis. Metastatic sites and extent are not itemised.

The Table 1 row label for PTHrP is printed "Parathyroid Hormone0Related Protein", a one-character print artefact; the text names PTHrP with the same value and range, so the table row and text sentence are one observation.

The Discussion and Conclusions sentences about cholangiocarcinoma, HHM treatment and prognosis in general are literature background, not facts about this patient, except the stated conclusions about the case.
